title: Comark Test Stand Computers
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER.FA8125  AFSC PZIMA
detail_text: The Air Force intends to solicit a brand name requirement for the following: The 76 CMXG/MXDEC is requesting utilization of funds for the purchase of COMARK/Nematron Computers. The requested equipment item descriptions/specifications are outlined below. iPC1200AR-iC11-16GB-256SS-NOS-AC-AL-C1D2 • QTY – 2 • Nematron Industrial 12" Panel Computer TS • Intel Celeron 6600E • 16 GB DRAM • 256GB Solid State Drive • No OS installed • 100-240 VAC • Powder Coated Aluminum • FCC/CE/UL61010/C1D2 Certifications • COMARK Part Number: IPC1200AR-D6F00AA iPC1900AR-iC11-16GB-256SS-NOS-AC-AL-C1D2 • QTY – 3 • Nematron Industrial 19" Panel Computer TS • Intel Celeron 6600E • 16 GB DRAM • 256GB Solid State Drive • No OS installed • 100-240 VAC • Powder Coated Aluminum • FCC/CE/UL61010/C1D2 Certifications • COMARK Part Number: IPC1900AR-D6F00AA nPC400-iC11-16GB-256SS-NA-DVD-2S-NOS-AC-NA-C1D2 • QTY - 16 • Industrial Grade Node Computer with Expansion • Intel Celeron 6600E • 16 GB DRAM • 256 Solid State Drive NC • No drive installed • SATA DVD-R/W drive installed • One PCI and One PCIe x1 • No OS installed • 100-240 VAC • FCC/CE/UL61010/C1D2 Certifications • COMARK PN: NPC4A-D6F A Firm Fixed Price type contract is contemplated. Estimated Period of Performance: 90 days ARO System for Award Management (SAM) is required to receive any award. Contractors can register electronically at https://www.sam.gov/portal/public/SAM/. The NAICS code for this requirement is 334111 with a size standard of 1250 EMP. Interested persons may identify their interest and capability to respond to the requirement by submitting a proposal. Electronic procedures will be used for this solicitation through SAM.gov at https://www.SAM.gov/. No telephone requests. See Note 22. Authority is 10 USC 2304 (c)(1). For further information contact: Sondra Groth Contract Specialist
